reasoning: Started from the thread's quarterly driver set [41] and checked it against the filings in my lane. Red flags: (1) concentration: top-5 end customers 91% of 2025 sales and top-3 78% of Q2 2026 [6,8]; the 10-K shows a single-customer cliff already happened (Huawei 41% of 2024 sales, 0.1% of 2025 [8]); BofA flagged Garmin/Google reliance and opex delaying profit beyond FY28 [39]; (2) working capital: inventories 16.9->29.4 and receivables 7.3->17.5 in six months, manufacturing purchase commitments 7.7->32.2 y/y [6], while revenue is recognised on sale to distributors: part of the beat record may be sell-in; (3) insiders sold ~$22M Aug-Oct 2026 with $0 bought, 68% discretionary [17,18,25]; (4) short interest up ~54% since mid-August to ~11% of shares, 5.7 days to cover [19]; (5) dilution: shares 18.3M -> 24.1M in H1 2026 from two follow-ons [6,21] and a new SGX listing [6]; (6) the Apr-Aug rally was multiple expansion, not estimates [21], and a fund that bought on a high-single-digit sales multiple sold at target [24]. Weighed honestly: there is no litigation, no debt, $367M cash, and the beat record is clean, so this is a growth-durability and valuation risk, not an accounting or solvency case. Changes vs the set: US FY27 +15% (set +25%), RoW +40% (set +80%), Q3 at the guide top; FY27 revenue 159.8 vs consensus 177 (-10%, because the 2026 step is launch-driven and concentrated). Valuation: losses make P/E and EV/EBITDA meaningless (method-fit flag), so EV/NTM sales from 9 peers (median 5.43x; k-rule 5.06x) carries 85%, and a non-multiple profitability-path leg ($15.43) carries 15% to show how little earnings value the build supports. Moratorium appraisal accepted (-0.33/sh). Result $37.76, ~13% below spot; P10 $19.12, P90 $65.72 (log distance 0.68 down vs 0.55 up: a fatter left tail). Research was limited by blocked pages (Yahoo, CNBC) and paywalled out-year consensus. In-lane share is ~34% of sources (14 of 41) because the driver set's filing and consensus citations and the peer-data pages are required inputs; the lane-specific finds no other lane is likely to use are the Earnings Whispers Form 4 roll-up, the Equibles FINRA short-interest series, the 10-K Huawei cliff and the 10-Q working-capital build. Not driver-linked: the custom profitability-path leg (stated per share).

model_inputs.ebit_basis_note: EBIT = company non-GAAP gross profit - non-GAAP operating expense - D&A = GAAP loss from operations + SBC + severance + IPO-related bonus and transaction costs - the 2025 non-monetary gain (Ex.99.1 reconciliations). Q2 2026: -8.727 + 3.557 = -5.170 = 15.989 - 19.374 - 1.785 [5]. The company's own non-GAAP figures exclude D&A as well as SBC, so its "non-GAAP operating loss" (GP - opex) is EBITDA-like; this set deducts D&A to keep EBIT an EBIT (engine ebitda = ebit + da = the company figure). EPS in notes = company non-GAAP net loss per share (excl. SBC and D&A, incl. other income) on weighted basic shares, the basis of the guide and Street (StockAnalysis/Benzinga). Engine model EPS = EBIT / diluted shares (no other income) and is lower; Zacks figures are on a different, GAAP-like basis.

model_inputs.structure_note: Quarterly driver set taken from the thread proposal [41] (5 drivers, 100% of revenue driven, FY2025 base, FY26-29), with agent_3 changes to us_rev (FY27 +15% vs +25%) and row_rev (FY27 +40% vs +80%), and Q3 2026 at the guide top (37.2 vs 38.0). Legs: EV/NTM sales at the horizon (0.85; the playbook's early-stage AI hardware multiple, because EBIT/EBITDA are negative through FY29 so P/E and EV/EBITDA cannot carry value) and a custom profitability-path leg (0.15; FY33 EBITDA at peer EV/EBITDA discounted), plus the moratorium adjustment (-7.9). Weights are judgment, untested. No DCF (not a neocloud).

discount_rate.basis: no debt; engine sets WACC; no DCF leg

horizon_multiples.peer_basis: median EV/NTM sales of 9 peers 5.43x (range 2.48x STM to 12.5x LSCC; 5 genuine edge/low-power peers median 5.43x); own 4.97x on consensus NTM revenue 170.0; k = 0.8 -> 5.43 x (4.97/5.43)^0.8 = 5.06x

custom.name: profitability path (FY2033 EBITDA at peer EV/EBITDA, discounted to horizon)
custom.explanation: Non-multiple-led check required by the method-fit flag (losses): revenue FY29 199.9 (this build) +15%/yr to FY33 349.7; non-GAAP GM 50%; non-GAAP opex grows only 3%/yr after FY29 (134.7 -> 151.6) -> FY33 company-basis EBITDA 23.2; x 20.4x (peer median trailing EV/EBITDA of MCHP 32.2x / STM 20.4x / NXPI 14.2x, peers.md) = 473.8 in FY33, discounted 6 years at 12% = 240.0; + net cash at horizon 313.9 (engine bridge) + PV of FY28-32 cash burn -108.9 = 445.0 / 28.84M shares = $15.43. Says: on this revenue path and the set's opex, intrinsic value is little more than cash; the EV/sales leg carries the rest.

adjustments.note: central EV from moratorium appraisal [37], incl. the post-horizon revenue part discounted to the horizon; low -32.4 / high +19.9 carried in the scenarios

model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) us_rev FY27 +15% vs the set's +25% (with row_rev +40% and Q3 at the guide top) lowers the EV/sales leg from $47.38 (set drivers, same multiple, engine) to $41.70 (-12%); (2) the custom profitability-path leg at 15% weight lowers the blend by ~$3.9 (-9%); its 3% opex growth and 50% GM are low-confidence. (3) k = 0.8 standard. (4) Financing: no raise modeled (366.8 cash, burn ~30-40/yr): P(equity raise by horizon) ~10% (below the 20% threshold), but the company raised twice in 2026 at $31 and $78 [6] and an opportunistic raise on a rally is plausible. (5) Take-out: TI/SLAB precedent [16] is context only; no cited evidence of an AMBQ bid, so 0. (6) Peer net cash for AMBA/CEVA uses cash and equivalents only (marketable securities not in the tag), which overstates their EV slightly.
